## Structural measurement problems (fix before trusting any number)

1. **CRYPTO intrabar-vs-daily PF inflation = 0.29×** — legacy daily-granularity numbers overstate edge by ~3.4×. Always read the intrabar-truth columns.
2. **ETF slippage ≈ 234% of per-trade PnL** — no ETF strategy can pass the cost gate (G7) until cadence/execution is modeled realistically.
3. **FOREX data blocker** — `fx_prices` stale to 2026-02-09; nothing in FX can be forward-tested.
4. **Dashboard data is stale/mismatched** — `dashboard_data.json` asset_class_health is a 2026-10-19 snapshot with wildly different cohorts (e.g., ETF n=15 vs ledger n=590). The audit3 ledger (canonical resolved view) is the trustworthy source.
5. **Dual recency panels disagree** — 14d/48h panels (publishing dashboard denominator) vs ledger recency (canonical denominator) frequently conflict; trust the ledger.

4. **Concentrate forward testing on** EQUITY-BREAKOUT (pre_registered) + CRYPTO-POSITION (only BH-clean slice) — the two most defensible theses.
5. **Fix the 6 pods with 0 forward rows** (data blockers / winner-stays bugs) so the forward clock can actually run.
